boundaries: Hard-link paths count as separate file instances with the same original content; counts are not unique payload counts.
Partition tables, large offsets and corrupt mutations in Dart tests are explicitly synthetic/derived; they are not additional externally mastered disk images.
Successful read-only e2fsck and exact debugfs extraction qualify this corpus only, not arbitrary filesystem repair or writing.
